events.title: Ameren Q1 Earnings Outpace Estimates, Revenues Increase Y/Y
events.body: AEE tops Q1 earnings estimates on infrastructure-driven gains, despite weaker sales volumes and a revenue miss, while reaffirming its 2026 outlook.

events.title: American Electric's Q1 Earnings Beat Estimates, Revenues Increase Y/Y
events.body: AEP beats Q1 earnings estimates as revenues rose 10% and new load deals in Ohio and Texas support contracted growth toward 63 GW by 2030.

events.title: Duke Energy Q1 Earnings Beat Estimates, Revenues Increase Y/Y
events.body: DUK tops Q1 estimates with strong revenue and earnings growth, but rising costs and higher interest expenses weigh on its overall financial picture.

events.title: DTE Energy's Q1 Earnings Miss Estimates, Decrease Year Over Year
events.body: DTE lags Q1 estimates with $1.95 EPS and a sharp YoY drop, while ramping grid investments and data center deals to drive growth.
